name: ijcai-skills
description: A 12-skill depth pack for IJCAI and IJCAI-ECAI submissions: topic fit, submission checks, author response, camera-ready, artifacts, reproducibility, supplementary material, review process, writing style, related work, experiments, and workflow. Grounded in the official IJCAI 2027 CFP, submission process, Primary Paper Initiative, reciprocal-review and reproducibility pages, author kit, generative AI policy, peer-review principles, and COI policy re-verified on 2026-11-23.
